newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch state to issue two bonds, one tap in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dutch state to issue two bonds, one tap in Q1 1997.

text.p: The Dutch government plans to issue two bonds in the first quarter of 1997, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
The Finance Ministry will issue three billion guiders of the 7.5 percent loan maturing on 15 Jan 2023.
The outstanding amount on the issue on Dec 31, 1996 would be 15.2 billion guilders, it added.
The Finance Ministry will also issue three billion guilders of the nine percent loan maturing on 15 Jan 2001.
The outstanding amount of the issue on Dec 31 1996 would be 10.5 billion guilders.
On January 17 a new tap issue would be announced, the Finance Ministry said.
